title: Compatible locally constant maps admit a gluing
statement: For an open cover of a topological space, every compatible family of locally constant maps into a set has a locally constant map on the union restricting to the family.

source.place: Sheaves, Example 6.4 and Definition 6.5 (Tag 006W): continuous maps form a sheaf; for a discrete target these are the locally constant maps

proof.text: Define the glued map pointwise by choosing a cover member containing each point; compatibility makes the value independent of the choice.
At each point, local constancy of the chosen member gives an open neighbourhood on which the glued map agrees with a constant map, hence is locally constant; the restriction equations are immediate.
